whenToUse: A brand or design studio that wants loud type, client colours and a case-study index.
Agencies that take project briefs online and want a live-totalling enquiry form.
avoidWhen: A quieter consultancy-style agency site — use site-agency-01.
a11y: The brief total is announced via aria-live and a status region; colour floods are disabled under motion-reduce.
Check text contrast against each client brand colour you add.
